# Sharing allows people to try out 'car light' life style

### CoMoUK publishes annual UK car club survey

Mark Moran

11 June 2024

CoMoUK Annual Car Club Report: UK

Car clubs across the UK have helped to remove tens of thousands of private vehicles from the roads, with more than 780,000 members now embracing a ‘car light’ lifestyle.

A new report from national shared transport charity Collaborative Mobility UK (CoMoUK) shows that people who join car clubs cut their total driven mileage by 153 miles per year.
